questions.code_template:
def classify(nums):
    evens = tuple(n for n in nums if n % 2 == 0)
    odds = tuple(n for n in nums if n % 2 == 1)
    return evens, odds

e, o = classify((1, 2, 3, 4, 5))
print(___, o)
questions.solution:
def classify(nums):
    evens = tuple(n for n in nums if n % 2 == 0)
    odds = tuple(n for n in nums if n % 2 == 1)
    return evens, odds

e, o = classify((1, 2, 3, 4, 5))
print(e, o)

questions.solution:
def in_box(p, box):
    x1, y1, x2, y2 = box
    return x1 <= p[0] <= x2 and y1 <= p[1] <= y2

print('In box:', in_box((3, 3), (1, 1, 5, 5)))
